_comment: Single source of truth for the control-stack constants. gen_params.py / export_params.m
turn this into params.h. N_MOD modules, N_MOD-1 shufflers, 2 legs per shuffler.
ctrl.M = inv(G)*diag(kI), G from QSPICE S10i (switching model, 200 kHz, 200 ns dead time, bench NGE103
operating point; qspice_ident.py --du 0.02). Chosen over the Simulink BENCH M (Gate 4, 15 Oct): the
u_diff->i_comm gain is 140 A/unit on the switching plant vs 742 averaged; M200 is stable on both.
Backups: shuffler_params.<version>.json (Simulink bench, QSPICE S9i 100 kHz). mppt: unused with the DL3021.
